scenes.headline: The four parts every decision-model harness builds
scenes.sub: Five repositories, and a model that picks but cannot write.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Macaron! Jev picks from a list but can't write. Five repositories each built the same four parts around it.

scenes.text: A decision model only picks. Around it, every harness builds an enumerator, a question format, a confidence gate, and a composer for strings.
scenes.say: A decision model only picks. So every harness builds an enumerator, a question format, a confidence gate, and a composer for strings.

scenes.title: One step of System One Harness

steps.say: The environment's finite action space is compiled into typed questions: pick one, yes or no, or a score.
Every question rides one request: one model call per step.
A gate compares the weakest judgment with a threshold set by the action's risk. Above it, the action runs, and the trace keeps every probability.
Below it, the step is refused. Three refusals end the run with a handoff: the questions, answers and threshold missed.

steps.note: free-text parameters are refused at load time
steps.say: The price: the compiler refuses any parameter that would need free text. The operator supplies strings by name, before the run.

items.say: The search tool drops the result.
The browser agent escalates to a language model.
And the diffusion server takes three more reads.

scenes.title: Canvas probe: next_control accuracy
scenes.note: same model; the encoding of the state decides
scenes.say: One probe reads a game from pixels. Always answering the commonest key scores point nine seven. No encoding beats it; the best scores point five.

scenes.title: Jev playing Mario, live
scenes.credit: the project's own recording, System One Harness

steps.say: Yet in the project's own demo, Jev plays Mario live: one typed decision per step, logged on the right.
Under the game, the page states where Mario is and what's ahead, in plain sentences. That adapter makes it work.

scenes.text: The model is a policy you can swap. The engineering is the enumerator, the gate and where strings come from.
scenes.say: So the model is a policy you can swap. The engineering is everything around it, the enumerator most of all.

recap: Enumerate, ask, gate, compose: four parts
One call per step; strings named up front
scenes.say: To recap: four parts around a model that only picks, and an enumerator that makes or breaks it.
